verdict.rationale: Better Auth's security docs state that logged-in users can revoke their own sessions to log out from other devices or browsers, so user-side per-device session revocation is a documented first-party capability. The admin plugin evidence covers banning, roles and impersonation but never mentions viewing or revoking other users' sessions. missing for 10: documented listing of active sessions/devices with device metadata, admin-side session viewing and revocation, explicit revoke-all-sessions behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can let users and admins see active sessions and devices and revoke them individually or all at once

citations.quote: A logged in user can also revoke their own sessions to log out from different devices or browsers.
Sessions, email verification, and password reset included.
